title: yeasty pillowy portuguese stilton cheese stew
description: Hangover-cure portuguese dish featuring stilton cheese, combining yeast fermentation and pillowy texture. Perfect for a post-party breakfast or brunch.
instructions: Combine yeast and warm water in a small bowl, let sit for 5 minutes until frothy.
In a large mixing bowl, whisk together gluten-free flour, all-purpose flour, and salt.
Melt butter in a small saucepan over low heat, then add to dry ingredients, stirring to combine.
Gradually add yeast mixture to dry ingredients, stirring until dough comes together.
Knead dough for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Transfer dough to a well-oiled bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour, or until doubled in size.
Punch down dough and shape into a round, place in a greased 6-quart hot pot or Dutch oven.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until golden brown.
While bread is baking, melt butter in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Add milk and bring to a simmer.
Stir in Stilton cheese until melted and smooth.
Remove bread from oven and let cool for 5 minutes.
Dust with parsley if desired, then slice and serve with cheese sauce.
Divide into 6-8 servings, depending on size of slices.
